scope: Graphics draft controls and native menu/HUD input hints

cases.scenario: Open graphics, change each draft, then Back and reopen; engine settings and disk remain unchanged.
Apply VSync or frame cap with custom quality and render scale; preserve every original scalability field.
Choose each quality preset and Apply; inspect actual rendering, including changed render scale, without a window-mode change.
Cycle 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, 165, 240 and Unlimited; custom limits remain until edited. Measure effective VSync/frame pacing separately.
Change the engine settings object while a draft is open; Apply refuses until Refresh. Runtime console/driver overrides are not settings-object edits and require separate observation.
During a display trial and restoration, graphics edits and saves are unavailable; Keep/Revert, deadline and focus-loss behavior remain intact.
Apply without saving, then explicitly save and relaunch. Inspect the engine file and read-only/write-failure behavior; never infer successful persistence from SaveSettings.
Inspect current HDR, dynamic resolution and audio quality after ApplyNonResolutionSettings reapplies existing preferences; confirm expected host behavior.
Tab and Shift-Tab reach the campaign-name field and all enabled actions. Typing does not start a campaign; gamepad navigation retains fresh-name actions.
Switch keyboard/mouse and controller in gameplay and menus; observe matching native hints without consumed input or movement/interaction duplication.
Neutral stick drift and tiny cursor movement do not flip hints; intentional movement does. Check common controller cursor-emulation software.
Repeated UI initialization/shutdown removes the input preprocessor and leaves no duplicate observer; verify 720p/1080p and 100-150 percent text layout.
